description: shuut save reminder: after a shell command writes a video file with ffmpeg or a similar local tool, adds one note: the agent saves it to shuut with editor_save if you turned on auto-save (/shuut:autosave), else offers it once per chat. Reads only the hook input and whether that file is a non-empty regular file (a stat, never an open); sends nothing anywhere and writes no files.
